newsitem.title: FRANCE: Pontet to be named head of CIC -paper.
newsitem.headline: Pontet to be named head of CIC -paper.

text.p: Philippe Pontet, chairman of public holding group Erap, is to be named head of French regional banking group CIC, newspaper Les Echos reported on Thursday.
Pontet would replace Bernard Yoncourt, who infuriated the centre-right government for speaking out against the privatisation of Credit Industriel et Commercial (CIC).
The government has temporarily abandoned plans to sell the bank.
Yoncourt had said that the sale of CIC to a major French bank could spell the "death" of its regional network.
Pontet would be named head of CIC by Didier Pfeiffer, the new chief of the regional banking group's parent, French insurer GAN.
Pfeiffer replaced Jean-Jacques Bonnaud on Wednesday after he was fired by the government which said he also had undermined the privatisation of CIC.
